description: This source file defines the 'MasterIf' class, which implements the functionality for the '<if>' element in a mini-language processing framework. It handles conditional logic with support for 'then', 'else-if', and 'else' clauses, evaluating conditions and executing corresponding operations.

classes.name: MasterIf
classes.description: Implements a conditional 'if' construct within the mini-language, with support for nested 'else-if' and 'else' conditions, executing sub-operations based on evaluated conditions.

classes.name: MasterIf.MasterIfFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of 'MasterIf' from XML elements.

methods.name: MasterIf
methods.description: Constructor that parses and initializes the 'MasterIf' object based on XML element, extracting conditions and sub-operations.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the conditional logic, evaluating the primary condition and delegating to 'then', 'else-if', or 'else' sub-operations accordingly.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from all nested sub-operations for dependency analysis.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the 'MasterIf' object, including its condition.
